results.name: V39 hub direct entry renders the hubDTO test, meta and card links (EN, desktop)
V39 hub completed and in-progress badges reflect server latest scores
V39 hub draft publication shows the QA draft notice; published does not
V39 hub card click navigates to the activity route; Back and Forward restore both screens
V39 hub direct reload refetches the authorized view and keeps the hub
V39 hub keyboard: Tab reaches Back link then exam card CTA; Enter follows the link
V39 hub touch: tap on the card CTA navigates (touch emulation, 390 px)
V39 hub Back link on a cold entry follows its library href (no history on the page)
V39 hub locked (403 sequence_locked) shows the locked section linking to academic
V39 hub kind locked from the view shows the locked section
V39 hub not_found (404) shows the original not-found screen with no hub content
V39 hub malformed id never requests data and shows the not-found screen
V39 hub 500 shows the region error; Try again re-requests and renders the hub
V39 hub network failure shows the region error and no hub content
V39 hub 429 shows the region error and no hub content
V39 hub 403 (not sequence-locked) shows the region error and no hub content
V39 hub 401 ends the session: hub content is removed and the app navigates to /login (authority logout)
V39 hub unrecognized view kind is a region error, never fabricated hub content
V39 hub payload with extra transcript field is refused; transcript text never renders
V39 hub authored kind renders the sandboxed authored frame (allow-scripts only)
V39 hub in-app source switch (pushState + popstate) replaces the hub with the new test only
V39 hub in-app navigation during an in-flight hub request discards the stale response
V39 activity invalid route segments are not-found and issue no request (activity 0, 6, malformed id)
V39 activity segment 02 is activity 2 (original Number(segment) rule); 00 is not-found with no request
V39 activity 1 shows the original exam start; Start posts once and navigates to the attempt
V39 activity 1 start failure shows the original message; Retry resumes the same start path
V39 activity 3 Save progress posts complete:false with the typed gap answer and keeps it on screen
V39 activity 3 failed save shows the save-failed message and keeps the typed gap answer
V39 activity 2 rate-limited Complete (429) shows save-failed and displays no score
V39 activity 2 Complete posts complete:true and shows the server score (no client grading)
V39 practice matching: Check is disabled until answered; Check posts only answered questions and shows the verdict and key
V39 practice Finish is blocked until every question is answered, then sends complete:true for all
V39 practice Previous and Next move between questions and reset the prediction field
V39 practice completion: a text answer is sent as typed and the Test hub link returns to the hub
V39 practice retry with no missed questions shows the original empty message
V39 practice map: the plan renders and a location answer is submitted (ListeningMap)
V39 practice error (500) shows the common error and Try again succeeds
V39 practice while an exam is in progress shows the exam-locked notice
V39 activity 2 while an exam is in progress shows the exam-locked notice
V39 activity route: unknown view kind is a region error, never a fabricated activity
V39 activity 3 network failure on Save issues exactly one write (no silent replay)
V39 activity source switch via popstate loads only the new test activity
V39 activity 3 typed gap answer survives reload from the local draft (sessionStorage), not from the server
V39 activity direct reload refetches and keeps the same activity screen
V39 activity 2 authored-runtime redirect (kind authored) goes to the hub with no fragment
V39 activity 4 Commit and reveal stays disabled until a meaning is chosen; Save posts the chosen index once
V39 activity 4 failed Save shows the save-failed message and keeps the chosen meaning
V39 activity 5 vocabulary: folder list loads, a chosen folder is sent with the sense and term, then the panel closes
V39 activity 5 failed vocabulary save shows the vocabulary save-failed message and keeps the panel
V39 activity 5 Quiz: Check all answers is the graded Complete write; a changed choice clears the verdict (original answer() setResult(null)); re-check grades the new choice
V39 media lifecycle: leaving a practice route pauses the audio and detaches its source (in-app navigation)
V39 keyboard: Enter on the focused Save progress button of activity 4 sends one save (no pointer input)
V39 activity 3 write returning 401 ends the session (authority logout to /login), no retry
V39 practice payload carrying an answer key is refused (region error, no question rendered)
